messages.author: 65c82d09eac308cf
messages.subject: Release of seewave 2.1.6
parts:
Dear seewave users,

A new version of seewave (2.1.6) has been pushed to CRAN a few days ago.

Please see the changes listed below.

Enjoy,

Jerome

---

NEW FUNCTIONS
o audiomoth(): a new function to decode time information encoded in Audiomoth .wav files.
o audiomoth.rename(): a new function to rename in Audiomoth .wav files in a readable format.
o beep(): a new function to produce a simple beep to alert for the end of a process, for instance.
        o gammatone(): a new function to generate gammatone filters in the time domain (impulse response).
o read.audacity(): a new function to read Audacity time or time*frequency markers.
o specflux(): a new function to compute spectral flux.
o write.audacity(): a new function to write Audacity time or time*frequency markers.

OTHER CHANGES
        o cutw() and all functions using time limits: more accurate cutting. Thanks to David Savage.
o lts(): can now manage corrupted files (skip them and return NA values).
o lts(): a new argument, 'recorder', to manage the recorder used to generate the audio files.
o lts(): a new argument, 'rmoffset', to remove potential DC offset.
o spectro(), spectro3D(): a new argument, 'noisereduction', to apply a noise reduction filter on the spectrogram (image).
o spectro() and all functions based on the Fourier transform: the argument 'ftwindow' can now take the value 'gaussian' for gaussian shape Fourier window. By Andrey Anikin.

messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Release of seewave 2.1.6
parts:
compliments !!!!! great upgrade.

it would also great a new routine to extract info from Adobe Audition 3 (windows only) files, including marked sections. I don't know if the current multiplatform Audition adopts same data structures, however it reads Auditon 3 cues (marked sections and marked points).

Gianni
